query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
age as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
nationality as "Nationality",
encounter_facility as "Facility",
encounter_department as "Department",
encounter_type as "Type",
to_char(((encounter_start_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Encounter start date and time",
to_char(((encounter_end_datetime at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as "Encounter end date and time",
procedure_facility as "Procedure facility",
procedure_area as "Procedure area",
procedure_location as "Procedure location",
procedure_type as "Procedure",
to_char(procedure_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Procedure date",
to_char(procedure_start_time, 'HH24:MI') as "Procedure start (date and time)",
to_char(procedure_end_time, 'HH24:MI') as "Procedure end (date and time)",
procedure_duration as "Procedure duration",
procedure_clinician as "Procedure clinician",
procedure_anaesthetist as "Procedure anaesthetist",
procedure_assistant_anaesthetist as "Procedure assistant anesthetist",
is_completed as "Procedure marked as completed",
time_in as "Procedure time in",
time_out as "Procedure time out"
from "reporting"."ds__procedures"
where
procedure_date
>= 
:fromDate
and
procedure_date
<= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:facilityId is null then true
else procedure_facility_id = 
:facilityId
end
and
case
when 
:departmentId is null then true
else encounter_department_id = 
:departmentId
end
and
case
when 
:locationGroupId is null then true
else procedure_area_id = 
:locationGroupId
end
and
case
when 
:locationId is null then true
else procedure_location_id = 
:locationId
end
and
case
when 
:clinicianId is null then true
else procedure_clinician_id = 
:clinicianId
end
order by procedure_start_time
name: Procedures line list
notes: This report pulls list of all patients that have documented procedures during the selected date period
